One concurrent successor wins; a fork conflicts. Every successor is final: the ambiguous arm forbids reconciles fields, so an ambiguity-stage change is not a successor. A final head is terminal — no later Kovee receipt reopens it, a late result is retained as source-qualified conflict evidence, and an EffectGovernanceDisposition against an ambiguous receipt never closes this head (its own head is fenced source_advanced by this transition's Byom-side admission).
